notes.subject: ידליקם
notes.rationale: Tok bilong Hibru i min 'flasim paia / kukim' — figurative bilong wain i kamap olsem paia insait long ol; 'paiarapim' i holim piksa bilong paia.

notes.subject: מאחרי בנשף
notes.rationale: 'םאחרי' i min 'bihain long / ol i wet inap' — KJV 'continue until night', YLT 'tarrying in twilight'; mi usim 'stap lek long taim klostu nait'.

notes.subject: הוי oracle
notes.rationale: Woe oracle — tok i save go long ol man bilong Yuda we ol i dring nating.

translation: Sori tru long ol man i kirap earli long moning bilong ranim ol dring strong, ol i stap lek long taim klostu nait, wain i paiarapim ol.
